question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: prone

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Scared**: Fearful; frightened. (भयभीत; डरा हुआ)
 
• **Prone**: Having a natural inclination or tendency to something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति स्वाभाविक झुकाव या प्रवृत्ति होना)
 
• **Liable**: Responsible by law; legally answerable. (कानून द्वारा जिम्मेदार; कानूनी तौर पर जवाबदेह)
 
• **Resistance**: The refusal to accept or comply with something. (किसी चीज़ को स्वीकार करने या उसका अनुपालन करने से इंकार करना)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Due to the numerous personal and societal changes teens go through, they are especially vulnerable to scholastic stress.
 
• So, "prone" is the correct word choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete passage: *Academic life has (1) become __demanding for students as a result of different internal and external expectations. Teenagers are especially __**(2) prone**__ to academic stress because they go through so many personal and social changes. As a result, designing effective and efficient (3) __ __ solutions requires a thorough understanding of the causes and consequences of academic stress. Exams are one of the (4) __ __ aspects of anyone's life. Exams are stressful for everyone, whether they are students or adults because everyone wants to perform well and no one wants to fail as to avoid (5) __ __ in future.*
